Noah: Quick sync 1 - Nebula marketplace listing + partner integration webinar on June 9. Need inbound lead routing, landing copy, benchmark snippet, and partner lead delivery.
Lina: For tracking, use utm_source=nebula_market and utm_campaign=NEB-LAUNCH-0609. Add hidden field partner=nebula on all forms.
Diego: Partner prefers webhook but accepts nightly SFTP. We should support both; webhook if DPA signed. For SFTP, they asked for PGP encrypted CSV.
Priya: Webinar landing fields: email, name, company, role, region, interest_level (radio: low/medium/high), share_with_partner (checkbox). Default unchecked.
Noah: Routing rules draft:
- share_with_partner=true AND interest_level=high -> partner SDR queue (real-time if webhook else nightly)
- company_size>500 OR interest_level=high + enterprise_email -> Redwood AE handoff + partner notification
- others -> joint nurture (co-branded 6-email cadence)
Diego: CSV header sample for nightly drop:
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,country,role,interest_level,utm_source,utm_campaign,contact_id,partner_opt_in,region,lead_score
```
Lina: Add campaign_code=NEB-0609 to all paid ads and social. Put final UTMs in tracking doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/nebula-launch-tracking
Priya: Benchmark narrative: two scenarios (baseline single-node vs Redwood+Nebula optimized). Short methodology blurb: same prompt-set, 5 warmup runs, report median p50/p95 and $/1k tokens. Diego: I'll produce small CSV of benchmark numbers for the blog.
Noah: Assignments: Lina = UTMs + landing (due 5/25), Diego = partner delivery + sample CSV + keys (due 5/22), Priya = webinar page + run-of-show (due 5/20). Rachel-bot: Reminder created: "Nebula launch ops check" 5/23 11:00am PT.
Rachel-bot: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/nebula-launch-check
Diego: One more thing 1 : please include a short ad headline list for A/B testing. I suggest: 
A) "Ship integration-ready LLM features with Redwood + Nebula"
B) "Lower inference cost at scale: Redwood & Nebula"
Priya: A for dev-centered ads, B for SEO/blog. We'll test both.
Noah: Great. Drop any workflow screenshots and the sample nightly CSV into the shared folder before the 5/23 sync. Thanks :rocket:
